description: This file defines the EndpointOptions class which encapsulates configuration settings for silo endpoints in Orleans. It includes properties for IP addresses and ports used for silo-to-silo and client-to-silo communication, as well as methods for retrieving endpoints and binding configuration values.

classes.name: EndpointOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration for silo endpoint addresses, ports, and provides methods to retrieve or set endpoints based on configuration.

methods.name: GetPublicSiloEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint used for silo-to-silo communication, constructed from the advertised IP address and silo port.

methods.name: GetPublicProxyEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint used for client-to-silo communication, considering GatewayPort and GatewayListeningEndpoint.

methods.name: GetListeningSiloEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the endpoint the silo listens on for silo-to-silo communication, defaults to public endpoint if not explicitly set.

methods.name: GetListeningProxyEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the endpoint the silo listens on for client communication, defaults to public proxy endpoint if not explicitly set.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Updates configuration properties based on provided IConfiguration instance, parsing relevant configuration values.
